text:
alerts-bot: [ALERT] Smart-routing fallback-loop spike detected. metric=fallback_retries, window=3m, value=22%. likely caused by repeated regional fallback (eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1) + variant mismatch mapping to rw-13b-q8. paging platform-oncall.
platform-oncall: taking pager. quick status? which tenants and which model variants are affected?
harry: I see a flood of failures from hosted-api: validator errors and some 'unexpected_response' logs. many decision entries have route_tag set to null.
elena: can't attribute in console because route_tag missing — dashboard queries return "unknown" bucket. running quick dump of recent decisions:
```
$ curl -s "http://routing-int.local/decisions?since=1934566900" | jq -c '.[] | {id, model, variant, route_tag}' | head -n 50
{"id":"req_1","model":"rw-13b","variant":"rw-13b-q8","route_tag":null}
{"id":"req_2","model":"rw-13b","variant":"rw-13b-q8","route_tag":null}
...
```
ron: kafka consumer 'decision-log-consumer' lagging heavily on broker-b. consumer groups: 12k lag. running consumer-check:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server broker-b:9092 --describe --group decision-log-consumer
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
routing-decisions  3         442112          454200          12088
```
platform-oncall: consumer stuck could explain observability gap. any deploys to routing-service around that time?
deploy-bot: routing-service rollout: deploy_id=deploy-2026-05-18-11:42 feature/route-meta-v2 -> canary 15% at 1934566885. no auto-rollback.
harry: that aligns with spike start. suspecting schema change: routing-service now emits route_meta.tag instead of route_tag field. decision-logger expects route_tag. mismatch -> missing tags in logs -> alerts/readers treat untagged as fallback triggers.
elena: confirmed. sample payload from routing-service canary:
```
{
  "model": "rw-13b",
  "variant": "rw-13b-q8",
  "route_meta": {"tag":"eu-q8-autoscale"}
}
```
but decision-logger expects `route_tag` top-level.
opsbot: suggested short-term mitigations: (1) pin affected tenants in region eu-central-1 to stable variant rw-13b-standard via admin/overrides; (2) restart decision-log-consumer to clear lag; (3) rollback routing-service canary if pinning not feasible.
platform-oncall: will do (1) and (2) now. elena please provide list of impacted tenants.
elena: quick query shows tenants with >200 errors: globex (1.8k), hyperloop (430), minerva (260). starting override for globex only to limit blast radius.
```
POST /admin/overrides
{
  "tenant": "globex",
  "scope": "region:eu-central-1",
  "model": "rw-13b",
  "variant": "rw-13b-standard",
  "ttl": "15m",
  "reason": "temporary mitigation for fallback-loop"
}
```
platform-oncall: override applied for globex. restarting decision-log-consumer: `systemctl restart decision-log-consumer` on node-broker2.
opsbot: action recorded. monitoring for 2m windows.
ui-monitor: after override + consumer restart, fallback metric dropped to 3% in 90s. errors for globex down from 18% -> 1.5%.
harry: good. consumer ack progressed, lag dropped to <100. decision logs now show route_tag again for many entries.
ron: still seeing a minority of decisions with route_tag null: looks like some intermediate fanout path (fanout worker pool C) is still receiving new schema.
elena: checking canary distribution -> canary at 15% across eu-west-1 + eu-central-1. rollback option?
deploy-bot: rollback canary to stable at `kubectl rollout undo deployment/routing-service --to-revision=stable-2026-05-10`. can execute on request.
platform-oncall: rollback please. we can't risk further untagged decisions.
harry: initiating rollback now.
opsbot: rollback initiated. keeping overrides in place until we validate.
platform-oncall: monitoring -> within 2 minutes, decision payloads have route_tag top-level again. fallback loop metric returning to baseline.
elena: root cause: routing-service introduced new nested field route_meta.tag but decision-logger wasn't tolerant. missed schema contract.
harry: mitigation notes: (A) add backward-compatible emit of route_tag in routing-service; (B) add lenient parser to decision-logger to check route_meta.tag if route_tag missing; (C) add a telemetry counter in decision-logger for "unknown_route_tag_count".
ron: I'll open the ops ticket to add a consumer alert when average route_tag==null > 0.5% over 3m.
platform-oncall: action items and owners:
- harry: confirm rollback finished + verify no canary traffic (done) (ETA 10m)
- elena: create PR to update decision-logger parser + add metric unknown_route_tag_count (ETA 3h)
- ron: dashboard & alert for route_tag null ratio (ETA 1h)
- deploy-bot/product: change canary rollout policy to include schema-compat smoke check before canary (task created)
- platform-oncall: run customer impact sweep and notify CS for top affected tenants (ETA 30m)

elena: quick customer impact: globex observed ~3m of degraded responses before override, ~1.8k requests affected. hyperloop ~420 requests. overall fraction low but customer-facing latency spikes occurred.
harry: I'll draft short incident update for CS with timeline and mitigation.
opsbot: severity downgraded to P3. recommend postmortem and add labels: routing, observability, schema-compat.
platform-oncall: handoff to eng-sre for post-incident follow-up at 1934567150. leaving overrides in place until tomorrow 08:00 UTC while fixes land. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
alerts-bot: HANDOFF recorded. logs archived to /var/log/incidents/1934567001/decision-dump.json. please run postmortem within 72h and link to the PRs.
